case: `AdmissionRecord.failed_predicate_id` goes back to a free string, so the text `unfamiliar wording` is an admissible failed predicate again.
why: F6D-09: this restores the committed state the finding measured. `guard.admission.refusal_names_failed_predicate` asserts the field is nonempty and not the empty string, which `unfamiliar wording` satisfies -- and that phrase is what the guard's own meaning says is NOT a predicate. Adverse case 13 and benign case 17 both turn on the distinction, and only the TYPE carries it. A nonempty check cannot be strengthened into this; the field has to be the derived, ratcheted enum of registry keys.
expect_failure_contains: A FIELD THAT NAMES A PREDICATE IS A FREE STRING
